technicalCause: The credential-path classifier treated the Python 3.12 standard-library module MigrationRuntime/Python/Lib/lib2to3/pgen2/token.py as credential material because its basename is token.py.
securityFinding: No credential, account, Unity activation, token value, password, private key, or secret was present or copied. This was a path-name false positive before Unity was launched.
forwardFix: A new attempt may allow only the three exact Python standard-library module paths secrets.py and token.py while retaining every other credential-path prohibition.
